examples.text: Ik zal zorgen dat alles op tijd klaar is.
examples.english: I will make sure everything is ready on time.
examples.translation: I will make sure everything is ready on time.

examples.text: De anderhalvemetereconomie zorgt ervoor dat huisartsen- en ziekenhuiszorg zo georganiseerd moeten worden dat patiënten, letterlijk en figuurlijk, waar dat kan zo veel mogelijk ob afstand worden gehouden tot er een vaccin gevonden is en dat breed wordt toegepast.
examples.english: The one-and-a-half-meter economy means that general practitioners and hospitals must be organized so that, literally and figuratively, patients are distanced as much as possible until a vaccine is available and has been widely distributed.
examples.translation: The one-and-a-half-meter economy means that general practitioners and hospitals must be organized so that, literally and figuratively, patients are distanced as much as possible until a vaccine is available and has been widely distributed.

examples.text: Uit enkele speakers dendert soca en zouk muziek^([sic]). In de lucht hangt de geur van versgebakken bara's en kip.
examples.english: Soca and zouk music thumps from a couple of loudspeakers. The smell of freshly fried baras and chicken wafts through the air.
examples.translation: Soca and zouk music thumps from a couple of loudspeakers. The smell of freshly fried baras and chicken wafts through the air.
